pairs.difference: A has a clear ground and backdrop: rippled sand below, soft tone-on-tone orange dune bands behind. B has no horizon: an oversized ball sits on a flat pocked yellow sand plane with crater-like ovals, and its cast shadow turns an odd red.
pairs.fix: Make the ball smaller and let it sit in rippled sand. Add a simple horizon with two quiet orange dune bands behind it. Use a soft brown shadow.

pairs.difference: Both are shelf booths with the same bear prop. A is evenly lit, with a flat green plank wall and shelf brackets, and the target and bear stand apart inside the frame. In B the target and bear touch, the bear spills past the right post, and the green wall has a spotlit vignette above a dark red band.
pairs.fix: Separate the target and bear so both stay inside the frame. Light the back wall evenly and remove the dark band under the shelf.

pairs.difference: A keeps a muted green striped wall with a plain ceiling and soft diagonal window light. B has a hot yellow-green glow on the wall, a crown moulding, a larger unit, and hard-edged curved blue air ribbons laid over the stripes.
pairs.fix: Use an even muted green striped wall with no glow. Make the air faint soft streaks that fade into the wall, and make the unit a little smaller.

pairs.difference: A has deep blue water, a smooth quiet sand mound and a shell with two coins. B adds a bright cyan glow at the top, a stack of coins, pebbles scattered on textured sand and more bubble clusters, so the floor is busier (detail 0.0159 against 0.011).
pairs.fix: Use a deep even blue water backdrop with no bright glow. Make the sand a smooth quiet mound, remove the pebbles, and keep only one shell and two coins.

pairs.difference: A stays simple: plain horizontal plank wall behind a plank floor. B builds a room corner with a post, two skirting rails, a diagonal shadow across the wall and dark upper planks, so the backdrop has several structural shapes competing with the cap.
pairs.fix: Replace the room corner with one plain warm plank wall behind the floor. Remove the post, the skirting and the diagonal shadow.

pairs.difference: A has small tone-on-tone crowns on an even green wall, tied to the booth's crown, and a soft ground shadow. B has large tilted suitcase outlines unrelated to the booth, with a vignette glow behind them. Its detail of 0.0187 is above the real range of 0.008 to 0.013.
pairs.fix: Replace the suitcases with small quiet tone-on-tone crowns in even rows. Light the green wall evenly with no glow.

pairs.difference: A has simple wide blue stripes and clean plank lines receding under the gloves, which sit well inside the card. In B the gloves almost fill the width, the blue wall carries thin bright pinstripes with dark seams, and the wood is a blurred horizontal smear.
pairs.fix: Make the gloves smaller. Use plain wide tone-on-tone blue stripes, and a wood floor with a few clean plank lines running toward the viewer.

pairs.difference: A's concentric purple rings are low contrast and quiet, and the fins sit small within them. B's rings are more saturated, with a bright hot-pink glow behind the larger fins, so the field pushes forward. Contrast of the rings, not their count, is the difference.
pairs.fix: Lower the ring contrast to a calm even purple, remove the bright centre glow, and make the fins smaller.

pairs.difference: A shows the whole pier small and centred, with sky, clouds, foam lace, a caustic mesh across the water and sand specks, which is many small details. B crops in close on the post and ring with a few large water shapes and a quiet sand strip, like the real close-cropped lighthouse, though the angle is unusual.
pairs.fix: Move in close and let the pier run off the card edge. Replace the net-like water pattern with a few broad calm water shapes and remove the lacy foam.

pairs.difference: A has calm concentric pink rings and a smooth dune with three small tan stones, plus the palm's own shadow. In B the rings become a spiral that tightens behind the crown and competes with it, and the sand carries bright white angular rocks and scattered specks.
pairs.fix: Use calm concentric pink rings centred behind the tree. Make the sand a smooth dune with two or three small tan stones and the palm's soft shadow.

pairs.difference: Both are a wall, skirting and plank floor with a single locker. A has a soft purple-blue wall gradient and a cast shadow, B a flat purple wall and a crisper floor. A's detail of 0.0218 is only just over the real range. Nothing in the staging separates them.

A has soft horizontal pink-orange waves, tiles fading calmly and a pool corner, with the whole slide visible. B has steep high-contrast magenta waves running up the full height, and a busy tiled pool edge. Its edge density of 0.065 is above the real range of 0.011 to 0.046, and the slide crowds the card.
pairs.fix: Use low-contrast wide horizontal waves in pink and orange. Make the tiles plain and the pool edge simple, and show the slide smaller with space around it.

pairs.difference: A's rings are flat bands of periwinkle with no lighting, and the player sits off-centre with the cable curling into open space. B has rings with a soft bright glow behind a larger centred player, so the field reads as a lit backdrop. The difference is slight.
pairs.fix: Flatten the rings to even tone-on-tone bands with no glow, and make the player smaller.

pairs.difference: A has green rings that deepen to dark corners, staying behind the tilted envelope. B has lighter neon-green rings with a bright halo behind a larger, more upright envelope. Both backdrops are quiet, so this is a weak call.
pairs.fix: Deepen the green, remove the bright halo, and make the envelope smaller with a slight tilt.

pairs.difference: A follows a real category 3 layout: a low camera, a quiet striped wall, and a plank table leading to the plate. B is top-down on diagonal wood with no backdrop, so the planks and grain run across the whole card, with loose water drops added on the plate rim.
pairs.fix: Use a low front view of the plate on a plank table, with a quiet striped wall behind. Remove the loose water drops from the rim.

pairs.difference: A crops in on the door so the wreath is central, though its ivy is a dense curtain on three sides. B shows the whole arched door with frame, hinges, paving, cracked plaster and ivy. The wreath is smaller in a fuller scene, and the edge density is 0.12. Both exceed the real range, and the lens mask on B smears over the door.
pairs.fix: Crop in on the door so the wreath is the centre. Remove the plaster cracks and paving, and keep a few large ivy leaves in one corner.

pattern: Generated cards stage the hero too large inside a brighter, lit backdrop: a hot glow or vignette behind the object where real cards keep an even field. They also add environment: extra rocks, pebbles, stacked coins, moulding and room corners, plaster cracks. Patterns drift toward higher contrast or unrelated motifs, such as spirals, steep waves and large suitcases, instead of quiet tone-on-tone bands. Caveat: I picked B on 14 of 16 pairs and most are low confidence, so the glow and size cue may be over-firing.
